extCardText:
Discover new brilliance and maximum power in the Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield—Vivid Voltage expansion as more Pokémon V appear, including the newly discovered Mythical Pokémon Zarude! • 2 acrylic condition markers
• A collector’s box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized
• A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online
